name: Stella Biderman
bio: Stella Biderman is the executive director of EleutherAI, the nonprofit research institute behind GPT-Neo, GPT-NeoX and the Pythia model suite. Biderman co-authored The Pile dataset and works on open language models, evaluation and training dynamics, and has also held a lead scientist role at Booz Allen Hamilton.
known_for: Co-author of The Pile and the Pythia suite
Co-author of the BLOOM open multilingual model paper
